# Open chamfer terminals

Unmodified native C3 sequence capture 002 inputs and full selections from the
2026-10-22 cylindrical-corner checkpoint, for equal-distance, two-distance and
reference-angle chamfers. Each selects one cylindrical rim edge on a planar cap.

The cap contact must continue beyond the original edge end to intersect the
curved terminal boundary. The terminal cylinder's analytic surface is unchanged;
its finite parameter range must include the displaced boundary. Both wire
directions check immutable input, closed consistent material and STEP.

Independent material evidence comes from procedural intersections of two disks
extruded into a lens-shaped prism. Integrate their exact disk-intersection area
through the chamfer depth, with two quadrature resolutions. Controls exercise
unequal setbacks, both caps, reversed wires and rigid/uniform-scale placements.
Native sampled comparisons remain limited checks, not a global-error proof.
